finding: Actual 1987 photo 87_05_pizzalito shows PIZZALITO FAST FOOD sign below giant food/boat facade. 1988 gallery 882_15_piazza calls giant facade Le Bateau Fou and identifies a separate Pizzalito pizzeria next to it. 1991 map labels La Farigoule as pizzeria. Do not blindly merge three names or attach historical facade to La Farigoule without cross-year physical match.
